name: Copiloto Comercial - MVP Response Test v1

parameters.jsCode:
const message='Hola, vi la propuesta. Me interesa, pero quisiera saber si podemos empezar este mes.';
return [{json:{event_id:'test-'+Date.now(),channel:'whatsapp',contact_id:'contact-test-001',opportunity_id:'opp-test-001',received_at:new Date().toISOString(),text:message,opportunity:{stage:'proposal_sent',summary:'Prospecto interesado que recibió una propuesta.'}}}];

const e=$json; const t=e.text.toLowerCase(); let intent='unclear'; let urgency='unknown'; let human_required=false; let stage=e.opportunity?.stage||'unknown'; let action='clarify'; let reason='Insufficient evidence.'; if(t.includes('me interesa')){intent='interest'; urgency=t.includes('este mes')?'high':'medium'; action='respond_and_advance'; reason='Prospect expresses interest and asks about starting this month.';} if(t.includes('contratar')||t.includes('cómo hacemos')){intent='purchase_signal'; human_required=true; urgency='high'; action='notify_human'; reason='Explicit purchase signal.';} if(t.includes('precio')||t.includes('caro')){intent='objection'; human_required=true; action='notify_human'; reason='Commercial price objection.';} if(t.includes('no me interesa')){intent='negative'; action='close'; reason='Explicit negative response.';} return [{json:{...e,analysis:{intent,urgency,human_required,stage_recommendation:stage,recommended_next_action:action,reason,confidence:intent==='unclear'?0.4:0.9}}}];
